cohort: 99 patients with ectopic pregnancy (72 tubal, 20 unknown location, 4 cesarean section scar, 3 cervical)
finding: Methotrexate therapy for ectopic pregnancy was successful in 68.5% of cases, with success rates varying significantly based on ultrasonographic findings, patient complaints, gestational week, serum hCG values, and ectopic pregnancy type.
